name: Computacenter plc
research_rationale: Research still confirms the Oct Q3 earnings-quality case, but unchanged valuation gates and filing basic EPS decline keep the overlay neutral on the screen hold rather than challenging it.

weekly_updates.summary:
26 Oct Q3 RNS: Q3 ahead of expectations; FY26 adjusted PBT outlook raised to no less than £425m; committed backlog £12.6bn.  
Screen unchanged at hold (3w, neutral timing); P/E 25.5 and FCF yield still fail core cheapness gates despite filing-aligned FCF £257.6m.  
23 Oct interim RemCo chair appointment; no new audited accounts since 12 Oct memo.

24 Nov RNS: Hatfield capital markets event; no trading update beyond the 26 Oct Q3 notice.  
Hold screen unchanged (8w, neutral timing); P/E 22.8 and FCF yield now pass, but filing basic EPS growth remains negative.  
News is third-party commentary and US tech sentiment only; no new audited accounts.
